copy.tagline: 集成 WhatsApp 云 API 到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 WhatsApp 消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WhatsApp Cloud API into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add WhatsApp messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过 WhatsApp Cloud API 与用户进行一对一聊天。它会自动处理消息的收发，并管理 WhatsApp 的 Webhook 连接。
howto.when: 当用户通过 WhatsApp 向已配置的机器人发送消息时触发。需要先完成 Meta 应用设置和凭证配置。

say.text: 帮我回复 WhatsApp 上的新消息。
say.note: Claude 会检查并回复 WhatsApp 消息。

say.text: 给张三的 WhatsApp 发一条提醒。
say.note: 需要先知道对方的手机号。

say.text: 查看 WhatsApp 对话历史。
say.note: Claude 会显示最近的聊天记录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can chat one-on-one with users via WhatsApp Cloud API. It automatically handles message sending/receiving and manages the WhatsApp webhook connection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user sends a message to the configured bot via WhatsApp. Requires prior Meta app setup and credential configuration.

say_en.text: Reply to new messages on WhatsApp.
say_en.note: Claude will check and reply to WhatsApp messages.

say_en.text: Send a reminder to Zhang San's WhatsApp.
say_en.note: Requires knowing the recipient's phone number.
Claude will display recent chat logs.
